page.overview:
Who is Sérlait de Creigiau?

Sérlait de Creigiau was the wife of Bryton de Creigiau and the mother to Delwyn, her son from a one night stand with Bryton's half-brother, Anton the Younger. Her brother, Doireann, was killed in , which caused Lazare to put out a contract on "Leshy" who turned out to actually be Anton, a werecat.
